ownership.scenarios: Workspace, navigation, document tools, diagnostics and media retain their original integration collaborators and buffer ownership.
ownership.residual: Full-App state, screen and document presentation journeys remain for ORG-T22.
ownership.fixturePolicy: Existing per-file model sandbox and timeout policy; cloned suite support is pruned only when unused.
ownership.focusedSuites: Existing focused model and controller suites retain their original file-owned fixtures. Git journeys/panel and peek collections split by principal behavior; screen/where suites stay for T22.
ownership.statefulPeekFixture: Each owner retains the original local made counter and twoVaults closure where used, so direct ++made operations and helper calls share a cell. Pure read/parse/fake-thread helpers and mock restoration share one factory. ORG-T40 may assess this deliberate closure clone; no test body or fixture counter API changes.
ownership.testSizes: The largest new file is under 1500 lines. Cohesive auto-index, merge/rebase journeys and Git-panel branch/row-stability groups exceed the 1000-line aim while retaining their shared nested preambles and integration coverage.
